subject: Churn signals sync — updated probability badges & stage hygiene
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme-analytics.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Churn signals sync — updated probability badges & stage hygiene

Hi Sam / team —

Following our internal commit sweep I attached an updated commit list (acme_commit_list.xlsx) with refreshed "probability badges" for renewals across your portfolio. The quick summary:
- 9 accounts moved up >=10 p.p.; 4 accounts moved down >=15 p.p.
- Two accounts (NovaTech, ClearView) are flagged for billing / SSO blockers and currently have probability < 40%.

Ask: please confirm any outstanding procurement or billing blocks on your side for the flagged accounts so we can lock a clean renewal forecast for finance. If the flags are accurate, we'll mark them as "at-risk" in the consolidated forecast and exclude from committed ARR until verified.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 30-min commit-verification call tomorrow (10/29) — propose 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET.
2) Procurement to confirm status on NovaTech (invoice dispute) and ClearView (SAML cert renewal).
3) We (Sales Ops) will push updated badges into the HubSpot forecast after call.

I've attached acme_commit_list.xlsx and added a live sheet for you here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDeFG_acme_churn_badging

Thanks — looking to close the gap before chapter close next week.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme-analytics.com>

Date: 2026-10-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Churn signals sync — updated probability badges & stage hygiene

Thanks Priya — appreciate the heads up and the sheet. Quick notes from our side:
- NovaTech: still in dispute over usage overage charges; procurement has paused payments. They say they'll resolve by 11/10 but no ETA on legal sign-off.
- ClearView: SAML cert rotation is scheduled for 11/02; engineering says this should be a low-risk lift.
- For the 4 accounts that moved down, two are due to executive churn which we are also trying to stabilize.

I can join the call on 10/29 at 10:00 PT. Procurement looped in — procurement, can you confirm NovaTech timeline?

Sam
Sam Taylor
Customer Success Lead | Acme Analytics
sam.taylor@acme-analytics.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Churn signals sync — updated probability badges & stage hygiene

Priya — good work on the sweep. A few operational asks from Sales Ops before the call: 
- Marissa, please run the "triage playbook" on all accounts with probability < 50% and ARR >= $50k. Attach the one-pager we use (triage-playbook.pdf).
- Flag any account that requires legal/procurement intervention so Vivek can pre-authorize potential credits or hold exceptions.
- For the forecast, do NOT mark NovaTech as committed until procurement confirms in writing.

Priya, please include a one-slide forecast change summary for the exec review on Monday. Keep it high level: total delta to committed ARR, top 5 at-risk accounts, and recommended mitigation (credits, executive outreach, technical fix).

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

> - Flag any account that requires legal/procurement intervention so Vivek can pre-authorize potential credits or hold exceptions.

Done — I ran the playbook and pushed updates to the live sheet. Quick highlights:
- NovaTech: ARR $120k; billing dispute open; status = "payment hold"; recommended: procurement confirmation + escalate to AM for exec outreach.
- ClearView: ARR $75k; technical blocker only; EE says low risk but allow 10-day buffer. Reprobability set to 45%.
- Two mid-market accounts with exec churn moved to "at-risk" and we recommend targeted outreach.

I've attached the triage-playbook.pdf and updated the fold to show the rationale column on the sheet. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDeFG_acme_churn_badging

Marissa

Thanks all — great alignment. Recap / action items from the verification sweep and call: 
- NovaTech: procurement to confirm (procurement@acme-analytics.com). Until written confirmation, we will treat as at-risk and exclude $120k from committed ARR.
- ClearView: technical fix scheduled, we will keep it at 45% until cert rotation completes on 11/02.
- Two mid-market accounts: AM outreach scheduled; Marissa to supply outreach templates.

I've uploaded a short snapshot of the signed MA references that may influence credit decisions: acme_signed_ma-snapshot.pdf (attached).

Proposed meeting for final commit lock: Friday 11/06 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET — I'll send an invite after procurement confirms NovaTech.

Thanks,
Priya

Looping in finance and closing the loop on the ask:
- We need final, written confirmation from Acme by EOD Friday 11/05 for any accounts we are planning to count as committed in the November close. Otherwise finance will err on conservative recognition.
- If procurement confirms NovaTech but notes required credits, please include the proposed credit amount in the reply so I can build it into the month close.

If Priya / Marissa can push a one-slide summary (per Aditya's ask) by Wednesday EOD, that gives us enough runway. Otherwise we'll mark the $120k as deferred into the next period.

Thanks — Vivek
